What this is

Built for the men
carrying the most.

Most men have no space to decompress that isn't beer or screens. The Stillness Men's Series creates something different — a structured, facilitated container where deep rest is possible without vulnerability being a prerequisite.

We meet once a month. Same intention. Different date. Always in candlelight.

  • No experience with meditation or sound healing needed
  • No talking circles you didn't sign up for
  • No pressure to share anything
  • Clinically informed facilitation by an RCC and men's coach
  • Intimate group — intentionally capped
This is for you if

You're carrying something
you haven't named yet.

01
The stress doesn't switch off
You're productive on the outside. Inside, the dial never fully comes down. You can't remember the last time you weren't running on some level of tension.
02
You're disconnected from yourself
You know something's off but can't quite name it. A flatness. A distance from the things that used to feel good. A quiet restlessness that doesn't go away.
03
You're performing strength
You handle it. You show up. But quietly, behind all of that, there's a weight. And no real space to put it down — even for one evening.
Every session

The evening, held with care.

✦
20 min
Opening
A grounded talk on pressure, coping, and intentional rest — no performance, no icebreakers.
90 min
Sound Journey
Crystal bowls guide your nervous system into deep rest. Lie back, eye mask on, let the sound do the work.
15 min
Reflection
Optional journaling with prompts. Your words stay private. No sharing required.
10 min
Integration
Snacks, water, and a gentle return. Leave when you're ready.
